user_operational_requirement: Top-performance core policy training must remain practical; approximately three months is the maximum acceptable wall-clock horizon rather than an architecture whose convergence would require years or decades.

hard_cap.scope: complete official core baseline training from the start of R8.3 through completed R8.4 and R8.5 frozen HU+3H production policy artifacts for every selected production profile and every required algorithm-seed stream
excluded_from_training_clock: R9 strategic audit performed after model training is complete
R11 opponent-data accumulation / safe exploitation overlay

planning_reserve.rule: The 20% operational reserve is inside, not in addition to, the 90-day hard ceiling. A 75-day nominal conservative upper-bound projection consumes the entire 90-day budget after reserve.

representation_state_at_freeze.interpretation: Richer V2 semantic representations were evaluated but did not satisfy the frozen promotion cascade. The compact V1 control remains selected; additional semantic richness must not be retained merely because it exists in legacy sources.

physical_measurement_contract.target: intended production Ryzen host or another explicitly frozen production compute topology
timing_unit_includes: all neural Advantage/ensemble fitting required by that production iteration
policy fitting work attributable to the frozen plan
serialization and durable checkpoint/transaction overhead needed to advance the scheduler
physical_measurement_contract.per_stream_runtime_estimator: maximum observed complete-iteration seconds across the repeated valid measurements
physical_measurement_contract.why_max_not_mean: The deadline is a feasibility ceiling; using the slowest observed complete iteration avoids an optimistic average-only projection.

projection_contract.rationale: Each stream remains serial under the persistent live RNG contract. Treating the whole stream as pinned to one worker is at least as restrictive as the actual scheduler and therefore does not assume unsafe intra-stream parallelism or optimistic perfect packing.

forbidden_deadline_shortcuts: reduce required algorithm seeds after seeing a runtime projection
reduce CFR roots/iterations or optimizer steps solely to fit the deadline
shrink the selected ensemble or uncertainty mechanism solely to fit the deadline
drop a selected production profile from the projection
introduce root-level/intra-stream parallelism that changes persistent RNG semantics
use GitHub-hosted runner time as a substitute for the physical production calibration
use mean-only timing when a slower valid repeated complete-iteration timing exists
declare trainability PASS before R8.0 and physical R8.2 evidence exist
allowed_engineering_optimizations: C++/Python hotspot optimization proven semantically identical
more efficient batching/vectorization that preserves exact accepted outputs/state
memory/layout/process-reuse improvements with regression-proven semantic identity
thread tuning selected by exact semantic calibration
concurrency across genuinely independent production streams
a different or expanded production compute topology only after its identity and semantically exact calibration are frozen
failure_rule: If the selected strategic architecture cannot satisfy the 90-day gate, R8 official training remains BLOCKED. Do not silently relax scientific gates and do not silently choose a post-hoc runner-up. Optimize the implementation semantically, add valid independent compute, or design a new precommitted strategic abstraction study before observing its outputs.

r7_5_4_interaction.rule: R7.5.4 may select a strategically justified action abstraction under its frozen cascade, but no larger action abstraction becomes R8-production-eligible until this absolute trainability gate is satisfied on the frozen production workload/hardware.
